site: The Signature 3D Print Mega Mall (provisional name)

sources.dedupe_note: Patent rows are deduped by record ID; any upstream duplicate IDs are reported, first record kept.

identity.tangible_id_standard: The permanent tangible ID IS the source record ID (JAH-SPEC-######, JAH-PAT-######, or patent publication number). One source record <-> one medallion. No parallel ID namespace exists by design.

source_types.SPEC: Signature spec draft — status DRAFT (not filed, not a granted patent)
source_types.PATENT: Public patent record — status PUBLIC_RECORD (publication identifier shown)

object.honesty: Each tangible is a commemorative emblem FOR its record — not a functional replica of the invention described.
object.generator: deterministic client-side medallion generator (assets/mesh3d.js; reference: code/mesh.py)
object.determinism: same source ID + same geometry version + same variant = identical mesh (cross-verified Python/JS, code/qa/test_determinism.py)

dimensions_mm.note: measured from generated mesh bounding box; keychain variant adds fused loop

object.gcode: No universal G-code is shipped; slice the STL in your own slicer.

browse: browse/ (static shard pages, 2000 tangibles each) + browse.html (human A-Z archive; lazy per-letter buckets in data/az/, manifest data/az/az-index.json)
